label: GO step after a rewarded visit to S2 (strongest after rare a1->S2 rewarded)
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.9% of mass), and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 holds 99.9% of mass). It never fires at D2 and almost never at D1. Within rewarded GO steps it prefers cases where the rewarded state was S2 (or the previous trial is outside the window): the recorded predicate covers 97% of activation mass on dev but has only 0.36 precision (dev F1 0.51), so many rewarded-S2 GO steps stay silent. Magnitude is clearly graded. The largest activations (top quartile, 73% of it) come after a1 -> S2 rare rewarded trials: GO & prev_reward==1 & prev_common==0 & prev_action==1 has precision 1.00 and 55% of the mass on its own. GO after common a2 -> S2 rewarded gives weak-to-moderate activations (precision 0.35, 28% of mass). GO after a rewarded S1 visit is mostly silent (a1->S1 common rewarded: precision 0.08), and so is a2->S1 rare rewarded (precision 0.02). Activations are also more frequent early in an episode (rate about 10% per step in trials 0-19, falling to 3% by trials 90-99) and when value is high. The best simple description is reward-from-S2 at GO, with magnitude peaking for the rare-rewarded a1 case, where a model-based agent should switch to a2. Only observed variables are used.
